svg.text: Data: docs/results/store.json, duckdb.tsv, 2026-10-22, AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads, 8g per server, 3 CPUs.
PostgreSQL 18.6, pg_sift 3.3, Elasticsearch 9.5.5, ClickHouse 26.9.19.9, Citus 14.2-1, pg_duckdb 1.1.1. pg_duckdb: the faster of its heap and
Parquet modes against the PostgreSQL of its own run.
